note: Every funder giving more than KSh 50,000 in a year, plus annual totals (decision #73). Underdogs Rising Group Limited's own contribution counts as funding and is listed. Amounts are published as bands once the year's accounts are drawn up; never estimate an amount. No money from political parties, candidates, aspirants, sitting officials, the County Government of Nyamira or county contractors.

rules.maxShare: No outside funder above about a third of our income. While Nyamira Daily is incubated, Underdogs Rising Group Limited is the largest source, and we say so.
